$comment: One stub per error code in docs/contracts/error-taxonomy.md plus unknown_error fallback. T-006 replaces these with the real localized strings.
unknown_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth_invalid_token: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
auth_missing_org: Please select an organization to continue.
forbidden_role: You do not have permission to do that.
unsupported_media_type: That file type is not supported.
corpus_empty: Your tenant has no approved corpus yet.
safety_blocked: This question is outside the assistant's scope.
verifier_failed: We could not verify a citation-grounded answer for that question.
quota_exceeded: Your plan's monthly quota has been used.
rate_limited: Too many requests. Please try again shortly.
provider_unavailable: An upstream model provider is unavailable. Please try again shortly.
provider_refused: The model declined to answer that question.
ingest_invalid: We could not read that file.
ingest_too_large: That file exceeds the upload size limit.
feature_deferred: This feature is not yet enabled.
internal_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
